channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: What to Know About the U.S.-Iran Peace Talks
item.description: US and Iran peace talks are at an impasse over Iran's nuclear program. Negotiations to end the war are at an impasse over Iran’s nuclear program and the Strait of Hormuz, which remains mostly shut.

item.title: Trump jokes U.S. Navy will take on Cuba on the way home from Iran
item.description: The Trump administration presses Cuba for reforms amid US-Iran tensions. The Trump administration is in the midst of a monthslong campaign to press the Cuban government to make dramatic reforms.

item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
item.description: Thirteen people were killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon. Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire.

item.title: French Catholic nun assaulted in Jerusalem, video sparks outrage, Israeli police arrests the
item.description: A French Catholic nun was assaulted in Jerusalem, Israeli police made an arrest. French Catholic nun assaulted in Jerusalem, video sparks outrage, Israeli police arrests the.

item.title: Spirit Airlines Begins 'Wind-down' After 34 Years In Business, Cancels All Flights
item.description: Spirit Airlines cancelled all flights after a potential White House bailout failed. The carrier announced it was ceasing operations after a potential White House bailout fell through. Spirit Airlines Begins 'Wind-down' After 34 Years In Business, Cancels All Flights.

item.title: Germany urges stronger European defence after US reduces troops
item.description: Germany's defence minister says Europeans must take on more responsibility for their own security after the US announced it would withdraw 5,000 soldiers. "We Europeans must take on more responsibility for our own security," says Germany's defence minister after Washington announced it would withdraw 5,000 soldiers.

item.title: As Israel Entrenches, Frustration With Hezbollah Turns to Support
item.description: Israel's demolition of villages in southern Lebanon is turning frustration with Hezbollah into support. With the cease-fire fraying and Israel demolishing villages in the south, many Hezbollah supporters in Lebanon are putting aside their annoyance with the group and turning to it for protection.

item.title: After Assad's fall, Syria's Kurds are left in limbo, feeling abandoned by the U.S.
item.description: Kurdish families in Syria struggle with cold and uncertainty after Bashar al-Assad's fall. Caught in limbo after the fall of Syria's Bashar al-Assad, Kurdish families struggle with cold, loss and uncertainty.

item.title: After Trump’s Ousting of Maduro, Little Has Changed for Most Venezuelans
item.description: Most Venezuelans see little change after the US ousted Maduro, despite promises to unleash prosperity. U. S. officials say they will “unleash prosperity” by commandeering the oil industry. Many people in Caracas say it will take far more than that.

item.title: U.S. withdrawing 5,000 troops from Germany, U.S. officials say
item.description: U. S. officials announced the withdrawal of 5,000 troops from Germany. Germany's Defence Minister said the move had been expected and that Europe needed to do more to ensure its own security.

item.title: Why US Oil Giants Are Making A U-Turn On "Uninvestable" Venezuela Now
item.description: Shipments of Venezuelan crude to the US Gulf Coast have risen in recent months. US oil giants are now investing in Venezuela after previously deeming it "uninvestable". Why US Oil Giants Are Making A U-Turn On "Uninvestable" Venezuela Now.

item.title: Former F1 driver and Paralympic champion Zanardi dies at 59
item.description: Former F1 driver and Paralympic champion Alessandro Zanardi has died at 59. Zanardi won numerous championships in both Formula One and the Paralympic Games. Former F1 driver and Paralympic champion Zanardi dies at 59.

item.title: Ukraine is hitting oil facilities deep inside Russia; soaring fuel prices could blunt the impact
item.description: Ukrainian drones are flying deep into Russia to strike oil facilities. The attacks could lead to soaring fuel prices in Russia. Ukraine is hitting oil facilities deep inside Russia; soaring fuel prices could blunt the impact.

item.title: Iran military official says renewed war with US 'likely'
item.description: Iran's military official stated a renewed war with the US is likely due to unfulfilled promises. The Iranian official said evidence showed Washington was not committed to any promises, hours after US President Donald Trump said he was "not satisfied" with a new Iranian negotiating proposal.

item.title: US to cut troop levels in Germany by 5,000 amid Trump spat with Merz
item.description: The US will cut 5,000 troops in Germany amid a row over Iran. The decision to reduce the US deployment to Germany comes amid a row between the two allies over Iran.

item.title: Iran military official says renewed war with U.S. ‘likely’
item.description: Iran delivered a draft proposal to Pakistan on April 30, 2026. Iran delivered the draft to mediator Pakistan on Thursday (April 30, 2026) evening, state media reported without detailing its contents.

item.title: Nepal celebrates return of stolen 13th-century Buddha statue from New York
item.description: Nepal has restored a 13th-century Buddha statue to its original temple in Kathmandu. The statue was stolen in the 1980s and returned to Nepal from New York. The Himalayan nation restores centuries-old statue, stolen in the 1980s, to its original temple in capital Kathmandu.

item.title: China urges reversal of UNIFIL departure from Lebanon as conflict escalates
item.description: China urged the reversal of UNIFIL's departure from Lebanon as Israel and Hezbollah clashes escalate, amid growing UNIFIL casualties. The UNIFIL mission has faced a growing number of casualties as Israel and Hezbollah continue to fight.
